descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-06 Admission Status Toggle · S07 Badge -> pre-selected template, override holds, picker matches what Generate uses (Hospital)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U8 The badge pre-selects the template at Generate: Hospital New Admission -> H&P, Follow-up -> SOAP progress, Consult -> Consult note; … (UAT TC-06; TFA-92584 AC 6; TFA-92584 AC 7)
  • U9 The physician still sees the template picker at Generate and can change the pre-selected template by hand; changing the template does not change the badge, and Generate writes the note in the templat … (UAT TC-06; TFA-92584 AC 6)
  • T2 Discharge templates (Discharge summary; SNF discharge once it exists) are never pre-selected by the badge in either context; they are only chosen by hand (UAT TC-06 step 6) (UAT TC-06; TFA-92584 AC 6; TFA-92599 AC 6)

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given Hospital patient; one hospital custom template

When Status Follow-up / New Admission / Consult; pick Discharge summary by hand and leave the tab; pick a custom template and delete it; Generate with Consult pre-selected (model calls mocked)

Then soap / hp / consult pre-selected; Discharge summary is only there as a hand pick, which survives a tab change and gives way to a new status; a deleted pick falls back to SOAP progress; Generate stores noteTemplate consult and sends the consult instructions

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions on 'Note Format' value, the generateNote request and the stored noteTemplate. Nursing Home cells are S02, S04, S16, S24

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S07 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-06.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: PW · Playwright script (PW (Generate mocked through routeWebSocket)) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: matrix (lane A).

UAT item: TC-06 Admission Status Toggle · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-06/S07

Badge -> pre-selected template, override holds, picker matches what Generate uses (Hospital)

Tickets: TFA-92584 Admission Status Toggle (ready for qa); TFA-92599 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch (in progress)

Result: passed in matrix/TC-06.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).

Existing specs:

  • encounter-type.spec.ts [chromium] — the status pre-selects the note format; the physician's own pick holds until the status changes — expected
  • encounter-type.spec.ts [chromium] — a picked custom template that is deleted leaves the picker on the format Generate uses — expected
  • encounter-type.spec.ts [chromium] — Generate writes the note in the format the status pre-selected — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A runs Tim's Playwright specs by title (spec-matrix.mjs).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
